title: Use qualified token-aware EqEdit mappings
when: A raw EqEdit script uses perpendicular/congruence or geometry notation.
do: Reuse normalization for standalone perp -> BOT and cong -> ==.
Preserve quoted literals, longer identifiers and arbitrary equals.
Reuse qualified rm identifiers, overbars and degree scripts only within their fixture scope.
check: Exact script/control identity; native glyph result for a new command/version.
limitation: Do not global-replace every equals sign or assume an untested square glyph is correct.
